ontario_vs_ontario.reason: Same maintained source and ontology definition (MEAN TRIAGE -> PHYSICIAN).

ontario_vs_alberta.reason: Same metric and event boundaries, but statistic_type differs (MEAN vs POINT_ESTIMATE).

ontario_vs_bc.reason: Same metric and event boundaries, but statistic_type differs (MEAN vs P90).

ontario_vs_quebec.reason: Different start_event and statistic_type (TRIAGE/MEAN vs REGISTRATION/ROLLING_AVG).
ontario_vs_quebec.divergence_brief: Methodology Divergence: Direct comparison is scientifically invalid. Different start points: TRIAGE vs REGISTRATION. Different statistics: MEAN vs ROLLING_AVG.
